card.name: Words right before hypoglycemia
card.fires_on: The word "of" (or "for") right after "risk" when the next word is likely "hypoglycemia", mostly in insulin and diabetes-drug dosing text. Also fires on "Se<<vere>>" before hypoglycemia and on a blank before a section number in a hypoglycemia list.

modes.label: Risk of hypoglycemia
modes.description: The linking word "of" or "for" after "risk" in sentences about lowering or raising hypoglycemia risk.
modes.example: Dosage adjustments are recommended to lower the risk<< of>> hypoglycemia when switching patients

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict hypoglycemia-related words next, such as hyp.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before "hypoglycemia" in insulin labels, as in "risk of".
